announcement.quote: BlackRock Announces Board Approval of New York Municipal Closed-End Fund Reorganizations

outcome_evidence.quote: BlackRock Announces Closing of Reorganizations of Three Municipal Closed-End Funds

deals.notes: Joint three-fund reorganization (BSE and BFY into BNY). BSE and BFY shareholders approved on the first meeting date; BNY common holders lacked a quorum, the meeting was adjourned to 2021-01-21, and the closing release followed on 2021-04-12. The excerpt of the 2021-04-12 release states that the reorganizations of BSE and BFY with and into BNY closed.
